briefs.explicit:
MISSION BRIEF L-008
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Time starts at t = 0 when every robot leaves its start location.

Locations (x, y, zone):
- base: (0, 0), outdoor
- water tower top: (-70, 69), roof
- office roof: (-127, -20), roof
- storage hall: (-31, -132), indoor
- control room: (70, -132), indoor
- workshop: (58, -92), indoor
- loading dock: (74, -67), outdoor
- east fence: (-59, -22), outdoor
- water tank: (38, 52), outdoor
- south yard: (-77, -135), outdoor
- transformer pad: (39, -28), outdoor

Robots:
- G1 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 17 kg), camera. Endurance: 4800 s, including the return to its start.
- M1 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 5 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2460 s, including the return to its start.
- M2 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 8 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 3060 s, including the return to its start.
- D1 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 9 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 960 s, including the return to its start.
- G2 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 2.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 18 kg), camera. Endurance: 3960 s, including the return to its start.
- D2 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 8.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1200 s, including the return to its start.
- M3 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 9 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2580 s, including the return to its start.
- D3 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 7.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1440 s, including the return to its start.

Tasks:
- T1: Inspect water tower top with a camera. Location: water tower top. Duration: 150 s. Needs: camera.
- T2: Replace the filter cartridge at control room. Location: control room. Duration: 300 s. Needs: robotic arm. Can start only after T8 is finished.
- T3: Deliver the replacement filter (14 kg) to workshop. Location: workshop. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 14 kg).
- T4: Replace the filter cartridge at workshop. Location: workshop. Duration: 240 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 720 s.
- T5: Collect a soil sample (1 kg) at loading dock and keep it on board. Location: loading dock. Duration: 150 s. Needs: robotic arm, cargo carrier (payload 1 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 480 s.
- T6: Deliver the first-aid kit (4 kg) to control room. Location: control room. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 4 kg).
- T7: Deliver the replacement filter (14 kg) to east fence. Location: east fence. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 14 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 120 s.
- T8: Deliver the battery pack (13 kg) to control room. Location: control room. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 13 kg).
- T9: Inspect water tower top with a camera. Location: water tower top. Duration: 60 s. Needs: camera. Deadline: finished by t = 300 s.
- T10: Inspect water tower top with a camera. Location: water tower top. Duration: 60 s. Needs: camera.
- T11: Tighten the valve at east fence. Location: east fence. Duration: 120 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 540 s. Can start only after T7 is finished.
- T12: Deliver the toolkit (1 kg) to control room. Location: control room. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 1 kg).
- T13: Tighten the valve at east fence. Location: east fence. Duration: 270 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T14: Deliver the first-aid kit (12 kg) to loading dock. Location: loading dock. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 12 kg).
- T15: Run a thermal scan of transformer pad. Location: transformer pad. Duration: 150 s. Needs: thermal camera.
- T16: Deliver the sensor box (9 kg) to south yard. Location: south yard. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 9 kg).

Rules:
1. Every task is done by exactly one robot. A robot does its tasks one at a time, in the order you list them, travelling between task locations.
2. A robot can only do a task if it has the needed equipment, enough payload capacity, and can reach the task location.
3. A task that must start after another task waits until that task is finished, even if a different robot does it.
4. Each robot must be back at its start location before its endurance runs out.
5. Keep at least 1 quadcopter on standby: it must not be given any task.
6. Every task must be finished by t = 900 s.

Objective: minimise the finish time of the last task (the makespan).
briefs.informal:
Here's what we need from the robots today.

Positions are in metres from the base at (0, 0). Drones fly straight and can't go indoors; ground robots follow the road grid (so they travel |dx| + |dy|) and can't get onto roofs. Everyone leaves their start spot at time zero.

Places: water tower top (-70, 69, a rooftop); office roof (-127, -20, a rooftop); storage hall (-31, -132, indoors); control room (70, -132, indoors); workshop (58, -92, indoors); loading dock (74, -67, outside); east fence (-59, -22, outside); water tank (38, 52, outside); south yard (-77, -135, outside); transformer pad (39, -28, outside).

The fleet: G1 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 17 kg at 1.5 m/s and runs for 80 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera. M1 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 5 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 41 minutes including getting back. M2 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 8 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 51 minutes including getting back. D1 is a quadcopter at base with a camera and a thermal camera; it flies at 9 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 16 minutes including the flight home. G2 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 18 kg at 2.5 m/s and runs for 66 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera. D2 is a quadcopter at base with a camera; it flies at 8.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 20 minutes including the flight home. M3 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 9 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 43 minutes including getting back. D3, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera and a thermal camera, cruises at 7.5 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 24 minutes of flight time, return trip included.

Jobs:
(T1) Do a visual check of water tower top - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T2) Swap the filter cartridge at control room - that takes 5 minutes on site but only once the battery pack (T8) has arrived.
(T3) Workshop needs the replacement filter, which weighs 14 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T4) Change the filter at workshop - that takes 4 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 12 minutes.
(T5) Pick up a soil sample at loading dock and keep it on board; it weighs 1 kg - that takes 2.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 8 minutes.
(T6) Get the first-aid kit (4 kg) over to control room - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T7) Drop the replacement filter off at east fence; it weighs 14 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 2 minutes.
(T8) Drop the battery pack off at control room; it weighs 13 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T9) Do a visual check of water tower top - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 5 minutes.
(T10) Get eyes on water tower top and check the panels - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T11) The valve at east fence needs tightening - that takes 2 minutes on site but only once the replacement filter (T7) has arrived and it has to be finished within the first 9 minutes.
(T12) Drop the toolkit off at control room; it weighs 1 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T13) Someone has to tighten the valve at east fence - that takes 4.5 minutes on site.
(T14) Drop the first-aid kit off at loading dock; it weighs 12 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T15) Look for overheating equipment around transformer pad - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T16) Drop the sensor box off at south yard; it weighs 9 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.

Keep one quadcopter on standby; don't give it any jobs. Everything has to be wrapped up within 15 minutes of the start, and the sooner the last job finishes, the better. Every robot has to make it back to where it started before its battery runs out.
